claves: Bacilo grampositivo. Causa colitis grave y diarrea, a menudo después de que los antibióticos eliminan la microbiota normal del intestino.

imagen.autor: modification of work by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
imagen.descripcionOriginal: Clostridioides difficile, a gram-positive, rod-shaped bacterium, causes severe colitis and diarrhea, often after the normal gut microbiota is eradicated by antibiotics. (credit: modification of work by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention)
